title: The Lotus Sutra, Part 4
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: In this Soto Zen dharma talk, the teacher invites participants to reflect on times when they felt awe or wonder, exploring how these moments can impact our lives and contribute to transformations. They discuss the importance of experiencing awe as a positive emotion that shifts our attention away from ourselves and connects us to something greater. This theme is woven throughout the talk, which also touches on stories from Buddhist teachings, such as the radical inclusion of women in Buddhism, highlighting the potential for anyone to attain enlightenment through devotion and practice.
